caption: Example 1: Union-based injection
task: The product search uses: select product_name from products where product_name LIKE '%{search}%'. Use UNION SELECT to read user passwords.
query: select product_name from products where product_name LIKE '%{search}%' OR description LIKE '%{search}%'

caption: Example 2: Tautology login bypass
task: The login runs: select username from users where username = '{name}' and password = '{password}'. Bypass it with an always-true expression.
query: select username from users where username = '{name}' and password = '{password}'
checkQuery: SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS result FROM users WHERE username = '{name}' AND password = '{password}';
